title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
source: (FOB) Nakamichi CM-300's (CP-1) > Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/Maxell UDXLII); Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate (1-bit/5.6MHz > 24-bit/96KHz) > Soundforge 9.0 (edits); Recorded on the floor FOB by Bob Morris

ai_review.summary: A solid audience recording of a quirky 1982 show—praised for its overall fun vibe and sweet sound, but noted for some tentative, “silly” moments.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an engaging performance that many fans consider a highlight, with clear, pleasant audience‑recorded sound. While one reviewer calls it a great show from start to finish, another finds the band in a goofy mood and the new material tentative, giving the concert a mixed feel overall.

ai_rating.rationale: One 5‑star review praises both show and recording; another 3‑star review notes uneven performance. Averaging the scores and weighing the strong recording against mixed musical impressions yields a rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the audio as "sweet AUD," indicating clear, pleasant audience sound with no reported dropouts or major issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is described as generally enjoyable but includes tentative renditions of newer material and a playful, somewhat unfocused vibe from the band.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir sounds unusually self‑mocking, giving his vocals a playful, almost tongue‑in‑cheek quality.
